display.purpose: Key counters and dashboard page titles

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: High-visibility operational status indicator with colored dot.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid rgba(53, 208, 127, 0.2); background: rgba(53, 208, 127, 0.1); color: #35D07F; } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #35D07F; }

components.name: Telemetry Primary Button
components.description: Primary action trigger in high-visibility cyan.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 6px; background: #22D3EE; color: #0B1120; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; }

components.name: Console Stat Card
components.description: Compact statistic card displaying key telemetry numbers.
components.html: 30-Day Uptime99.94%Across all monitors
components.css: .ds-stat-card { background: #151F32; border: 1px solid #253247; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #8493A8; } .ds-stat-val { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; color: #35D07F; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-stat-sub { font-size: 11px; color: #8493A8; }

narrative.overview: NestPing is an infrastructure-grade uptime and telemetry dashboard designed for operators who monitor mission-critical services. The aesthetic rejects marketing fluff and oversized cards in favor of information density and fast scanning.
keyCharacteristics: Operate Mode Priority: Engineered for fast scanning and active diagnosis over visual spectacle.
Strict Semantic Color: Accent colors indicate state and action, never ambient decoration.
Tabular Precision: All metric counters and timestamps use tabular figures.
Layered Surfaces: Clear depth hierarchy from canvas to cards to structural borders.

rules.name: The Rarity of Red Rule
rules.body: Coral danger (#F05265) is reserved exclusively for actual downtime, active incidents, and destructive confirmation.

rules.name: The Tabular Metric Rule
rules.body: Every numerical value representing latency (ms), uptime (%), time duration, or clock time must render with tabular figures.

rules.name: The Border-First Elevation Rule
rules.body: Elevation is defined by surface color hierarchy and 1px borders (#253247). Glow effects and halos are prohibited.

dos: Do format all latency metrics with units (ms, s) and render them with tabular figures.
Do keep table headers compact, uppercase, and colored with #8493A8.
Do provide instant toast feedback on every state mutation.
Do ensure interactive elements have clear focus outlines in primary cyan (#22D3EE).
donts: Don't use decorative gradients across page backgrounds or card surfaces.
Don't use emojis as operational status indicators.
Don't use glowing halos or continuous animated pulses on status indicators during normal operation.
Don't add decorative illustrations or marketing banners inside an operator's workspace.
